topology_reasoning: The target is a single connected, 4-way symmetric primitive centered in a square footprint.
It is best described as two orthogonal tapered waveguide bodies (horizontal and vertical) that overlap at the center, producing a clover/cross outline.
Each arm is straight on-center and narrows toward the tip; the black region is not a routing network, ring, or multi-stage interferometer.
Function-defining knobs are the arm reach and the width profile along the arm: center width, intermediate shoulder width, mid width, and tip width.
notes: Target image copied to component.png in this directory.

iterations.change_made: Initial four-arm straight-path recreation with a monotone taper profile; measured diff showed the arms were too narrow through the mid-body.
Broadened the arm profile with a mid-body bulge and added flattened GDS export so the knob verifier can read top-level polygons.
